name: STOP
meaning: Full stop at line/crosswalk/intersection, yield before proceeding.

quiz.question: What does a standard eight-sided (octagon) red sign signify to a driver?
options: Yield the right-of-way to cross traffic
Stop completely and proceed only when it is safe to do so
quiz.answer: Stop completely and proceed only when it is safe to do so

name: STOP ARRÊT (BILINGUAL)
meaning: Mandatory full stop in designated bilingual regions of Ontario.

quiz.question: You see a stop sign that displays both the words 'STOP' and 'ARRÊT'. What does this indicate?
options: A standard stop sign used in bilingual or designated French-language areas in Ontario
An all-way stop intersection where everyone must stop
A temporary stop sign used only in construction zones
quiz.answer: A standard stop sign used in bilingual or designated French-language areas in Ontario

name: DO NOT ENTER
meaning: Entering this roadway is strictly prohibited; typically posted at one-way street exits.

quiz.question: A regulatory sign features a solid red circle with a horizontal white bar running through the middle. What does this mean?
options: The road is closed for construction
quiz.answer: Do not enter this roadway

name: NO STOPPING BETWEEN SIGNS
meaning: Stopping is strictly prohibited in the designated zone between these signs.

quiz.question: A white square sign contains a black arrow pointing downward to the left, with two smaller arrows pointing to the left and right at the bottom. It features a red circle with a diagonal slash over it. What does this indicate?
options: Do not stop in the area between the signs
quiz.answer: Do not stop in the area between the signs

name: NO U-TURN
meaning: Making a U-turn (reversing direction) is strictly illegal at this location.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a solid red circle and a red diagonal slash over a black arrow looping backward in a 'U' shape. What maneuver is forbidden here?
quiz.answer: A U-turn

name: NO LEFT TURN
meaning: Turning left is strictly prohibited at this intersection or driveway.

quiz.question: A white square sign shows a black arrow pointing to the left, enclosed in a red circle with a red diagonal slash through it. What does this mean?
options: Winding road ahead to the left
quiz.answer: No left turn permitted

name: NO PASSING
meaning: Overtaking or passing other vehicles on this section of the road is prohibited.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a red circle and a red diagonal slash over two passenger vehicles side-by-side (one black, one red). What rule does this enforce?
options: No parking on either side of the road
No passing or overtaking another vehicle
quiz.answer: No passing or overtaking another vehicle

name: NO STRAIGHT THROUGH
meaning: Proceeding straight through this intersection is prohibited; a turn must be made.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a black arrow pointing straight up inside a solid red circle with a red diagonal slash through it. What constraint does this place on the driver?
options: Do not drive through the intersection / No straight through
quiz.answer: Do not drive through the intersection / No straight through

name: BICYCLES PROHIBITED
meaning: Bicycles are completely barred from utilizing this roadway asset.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a black border and a red circle with a diagonal slash across a symbol of a bicycle. What rule does this impose?
options: Bicycles must yield to vehicular traffic
Bicycles are strictly prohibited on this road
quiz.answer: Bicycles are strictly prohibited on this road

name: DANGEROUS GOODS PROHIBITED
meaning: Vehicles transporting dangerous goods are forbidden on this specific route.

quiz.question: A regulatory sign features a black box/cylinder symbol inside a red circle with a diagonal slash across it. What class of vehicles is prohibited from using this road?
quiz.answer: Vehicles transporting dangerous goods

name: PEDESTRIANS PROHIBITED
meaning: Pedestrians are forbidden from walking along or crossing the highway/ramp here.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a red circle and a red diagonal slash over a black silhouette of a person walking. What does this signify?
options: No pedestrians allowed on this roadway
quiz.answer: No pedestrians allowed on this roadway

name: ROAD CLOSED
meaning: The road ahead is physically closed to all public vehicular through traffic.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign displays a solid red circle with a white horizontal bar, and has the explicit text 'ROAD CLOSED' written directly below it. What does this mean?
options: The road is restricted to commercial trucks only
The road is completely closed to all through traffic
A detour route begins in 1 kilometer
quiz.answer: The road is completely closed to all through traffic

name: NO PARKING
meaning: Parking is strictly prohibited in the designated area.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a large black letter 'P' inside a solid red circle with a red diagonal slash through it. What regulation does this mark?
quiz.answer: No parking permitted

name: YIELD
meaning: Slow down, prepare to stop if necessary, yield right-of-way to oncoming traffic.

quiz.question: An inverted triangle sign (pointing downward) features a thick red border and a white center. What must a driver do when approaching it?
options: Come to a mandatory full stop in all conditions
Yield the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or through-street
Accelerate to merge with the flow of traffic
Maintain speed as you have the automatic right-of-way
quiz.answer: Yield the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or through-street

name: SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE
meaning: Mounted on vehicles traveling less than 40 km/h; use extreme caution.

quiz.question: A slow-moving vehicle sign is characterized by what specific geometric shape and color layout?
options: An orange triangle with a reflective red border
A yellow diamond with a black border
A white square with a red circle
An orange octagon with a black border
quiz.answer: An orange triangle with a reflective red border

name: NO RIGHT TURN
meaning: Turning right is strictly prohibited at this location.

quiz.question: A white square sign shows a black arrow pointing to the right, enclosed in a red circle with a red diagonal slash through it. What does this mean?
quiz.answer: No right turn permitted

name: NO RIGHT TURN ON RED LIGHT
meaning: Prohibits executing a right turn while facing a red traffic light signal; wait for a green signal.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign shows a red circle and diagonal slash over a right-turning arrow, positioned directly above a standard vertical three-lamp traffic signal icon. What restriction does this enforce?
options: No right turns permitted at any time
No right turn on a red light
Right turn only when the light is green
No parking near the intersection traffic signal
quiz.answer: No right turn on a red light

name: NO STOPPING FIRE LANE
meaning: Designates a fire lane where stopping commercial vehicles or transport trucks is prohibited to maintain emergency access.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign features a red circle enclosing the letters 'ST' and 'P' with a diagonal slash through it. Below it, a silhouette of a transport truck is displayed. What does this mean?
options: No trucks allowed on this route
No stopping in the designated fire lane
quiz.answer: No stopping in the designated fire lane

name: ACCESSIBLE PARKING BY PERMIT ONLY
meaning: Parking in the designated space is strictly prohibited unless the vehicle displays a valid accessible/disabled parking permit.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign displays a red circle and slash over a black letter 'P', with a blue wheelchair graphic and the text 'BY PERMIT ONLY' underneath. What rule does this impose?
options: Parking is permitted for everyone with a paid permit
No parking except for vehicles displaying a valid disabled person parking permit
No parking for any vehicles during peak hours
A designated wheelchair crossing area ahead
quiz.answer: No parking except for vehicles displaying a valid disabled person parking permit

name: NO PARKING SPECIFIC TIMES
meaning: Prohibits parking during the specific hours and days of the week explicitly listed on the placard.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign displays a red circle and slash over a letter 'P' with specific time text like '9 AM - 4 PM' and 'MON-FRI'. What does this indicate?
options: Parking is allowed only between 9 AM and 4 PM on weekdays
No parking during the specific times and days shown
No parking on weekends between 9 AM and 4 PM
Parking is unrestricted outside of business hours
quiz.answer: No parking during the specific times and days shown

name: NO PARKING BOTH SIDES
meaning: The double-ended arrow means the parking restriction applies to both sides of the roadway from the point where the sign is posted.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign features a red circle and slash over a letter 'P' with two small horizontal arrows at the bottom pointing left and right. What does this enforce?
options: No parking on either side of the sign
Parking is permitted on both sides with a permit
No parking during peak traffic hours
A dead end road layout begins here
quiz.answer: No parking on either side of the sign

name: PASSING PERMITTED
meaning: A green circle represents a permissive instruction; when enclosing two side-by-side cars, it indicates passing/overtaking is permitted.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign displays a green circle enclosing a silhouette of two passenger vehicles side-by-side. What does this indicate?
quiz.answer: Passing is permitted

name: DANGEROUS GOODS ROUTE
meaning: Marks an authorized route that vehicles carrying dangerous goods are permitted and required to use.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a solid green circle enclosing a solid black diamond symbol. What does this sign indicate?
quiz.answer: Designated dangerous goods route

name: PERMISSIVE SIGN INDICATOR
meaning: A solid green circle acts as a permissive indicator, signaling that the general action or entry is allowed unless modified.

quiz.question: A white square sign features a solid green circle with nothing else inside it. What general classification does this sign belong to?
quiz.answer: A permissive sign

name: RIGHT TURN ONLY (PERMISSIVE)
meaning: Mandates that traffic in this specific lane or intersection must turn right only.

quiz.question: A square white sign shows a solid green circle enclosing a black arrow that points straight up and then bends sharply to the right. What requirement does this place on the driver?
options: Sharp turn to the right ahead
quiz.answer: Right turn only

name: STRAIGHT THROUGH ONLY
meaning: Indicates a mandatory straight-only lane requirement where turning left or right is illegal.

quiz.question: A square white sign shows a solid green circle enclosing a black arrow pointing straight up. What mandatory movement does this dictate?
options: Proceed straight through only; no turns permitted
quiz.answer: Proceed straight through only; no turns permitted

name: LEFT TURN ONLY (PERMISSIVE)
meaning: Establishes a mandatory left-turn-only regulation for drivers in that lane.

quiz.question: A square white sign features a solid green circle enclosing a black arrow that points straight up and then bends sharply to the left. What does this indicate?
options: Sharp curve to the left ahead
quiz.answer: Left turn only

name: TIME LIMITED PARKING
meaning: Parking is permitted for a maximum duration of 30 minutes during the specified daytime hours.

quiz.question: A white rectangular sign features a green circle enclosing a large letter 'P' above the text '30 M' and '9 AM - 6 PM'. What does this sign permit?
options: Parking is prohibited between 9 AM and 6 PM
Parking is permitted for a maximum duration of 30 minutes during the times shown
Only 30 vehicles are permitted to park here
Parking is reserved exclusively for permit holders
quiz.answer: Parking is permitted for a maximum duration of 30 minutes during the times shown

name: LANE CONTROL RIGHT TURN ONLY
meaning: Mounted over or beside a specific lane, dictating that all traffic in that lane must execute a right turn.

quiz.question: A black square lane control sign features a white arrow that bends upward and sharply to the right. What does this signify?
options: The lane is designated for right turns only
A sharp curve is coming up on the highway
quiz.answer: The lane is designated for right turns only

name: LANE CONTROL STRAIGHT THROUGH ONLY
meaning: Indicates that the specific lane is designated exclusively for traffic proceeding straight ahead.

quiz.question: A black square lane control sign features a white arrow pointing straight up. What rule applies to drivers traveling in this lane?
options: This lane is for through traffic only; no turns are permitted from it
The lane turns into a one-way highway
Speed limits increase in this lane
Passing is permitted on either side
quiz.answer: This lane is for through traffic only; no turns are permitted from it

name: TWO-WAY LEFT TURN LANE
meaning: Designates a continuous, shared center lane reserved exclusively for vehicles from both directions making left turns.

quiz.question: A black square lane control sign shows two curved white arrows pointing in opposite directions toward the left. What is this lane reserved for?
options: Passing slower traffic on the left
The lane is only for two-way left turns
quiz.answer: The lane is only for two-way left turns

name: WRONG WAY
meaning: Critical safety alert notifying drivers that they are traveling in the incorrect direction on a one-way street or highway ramp.

quiz.question: A bright red rectangular sign reads 'WRONG WAY' in bold white text. What does this alert you to?
options: The road is closed due to construction ahead
You have entered a lane or ramp against the legal flow of traffic; stop and reverse safely
A detour route is beginning immediately
The lane is strictly for incoming emergency vehicles
quiz.answer: You have entered a lane or ramp against the legal flow of traffic; stop and reverse safely
